'''Rimebats''' were a [[Bat/Legends|bat]]-like species indigenous to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Verdanth]]. During the [[Republic Dark Age]], the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Narsk Ka'hane]] used to harvest rimebats from caves while wearing a [[Stealth suit/Legends|stealth suit]].
